vehicles_purchase_currency_paired.name: vehicles_purchase_currency_paired
vehicles_purchase_currency_paired.value: ("vehicles"."purchase_price" IS NULL AND "vehicles"."salvage_value" IS NULL) OR "vehicles"."purchase_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'

lodging_stays_cost_currency_paired.name: lodging_stays_cost_currency_paired
lodging_stays_cost_currency_paired.value: ("lodging_stays"."cost_amount" IS NULL) = ("lodging_stays"."cost_currency" IS NULL) AND ("lodging_stays"."cost_currency" IS NULL OR "lodging_stays"."cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

trips_cost_currency_paired.name: trips_cost_currency_paired
trips_cost_currency_paired.value: ("trips"."cost_amount" IS NULL) = ("trips"."cost_currency" IS NULL) AND ("trips"."cost_currency" IS NULL OR "trips"."cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

trips_budget_currency_paired.name: trips_budget_currency_paired
trips_budget_currency_paired.value: ("trips"."budget_amount" IS NULL) = ("trips"."budget_currency" IS NULL) AND ("trips"."budget_currency" IS NULL OR "trips"."budget_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

trips_arrive_after_depart.name: trips_arrive_after_depart
trips_arrive_after_depart.value: "trips"."arrived_at" IS NULL OR "trips"."departed_at" IS NULL OR "trips"."arrived_at" >= "trips"."departed_at"
